evidence.rev: AOTE PC817X product data sheet, version B1, release 2024-11-01 (12 PDF pages; PDF page 2 is printed page 1)
evidence.method: agent read the datasheet and viewed the page images: PDF p2 'Pin Configuration 1.Anode 2.Cathode 3.Emitter 4.Collector' with the package schematic (LED between pins 1-2 on the left, phototransistor 4 collector / 3 emitter on the right); PDF p3 absolute maximum ratings (IF 50 mA, VR 6 V, IFP 1 A, PC 150 mW, IC 50 mA, VCEO 80 V, VECO 6 V, Viso 5000 Vrms, Topr -55..+110 C); PDF p7 DIP4 outline (pitch 2.54, row spacing 7.6 +-0.2, lead width 0.5 +-0.1, lead thickness 0.25 +-0.1)
evidence.notes: Agent read, a person has not. KiCad Isolator:PC817 pin numbers 1-4 agree with the datasheet (1 A, 2 K, 3 E, 4 C), and the reflex fixture wires 1=COIN_OPTO_A (anode), 2=COIN_SIG (cathode), 3=GND (emitter), 4=COIN_IN (collector): correct polarity. lead_mm is the datasheet MAXIMUM (0.5+0.1 x 0.25+0.1). Pin abs_max holds only the forward/collector current and the collector-emitter voltage (VCEO 80 V, applied from collector to emitter); the LED reverse voltage VR = 6 V and VECO = 6 V are across-pin ratings, not absolute pin voltages, so they are not stored per pin. The abs-max table text extracts scrambled (columns), so the per-row values were read from the page image. Fixture says value 'PC817' but the LCSC part C20612594 is the PC817C (CTR bin C): the datasheet header gives CTR 80-600 % across the whole X series; the bin ranges are not tabulated on the cited pages.

notes: Machine data: jlcsearch (mfr PC817C, DIP-4, stock 180320) + EasyEDA 2026-10-27. Reflex U2 (coin-acceptor optocoupler). Hand-written because `parts new` refuses C20612594: EasyEDA's component TITLE is 'PC817C_C20612594' (it appends the LCSC id) while its 'Manufacturer Part' field is 'PC817C' and jlcsearch mfr is 'PC817C'. A is the LED anode, K the cathode, E/C the phototransistor. STAYS unverified, on purpose: `crosscheck` cannot be satisfied because KiCad's Isolator:PC817 has EMPTY pin names (name "" on all four pins, so only pin numbers and geometry can be compared) and EasyEDA names pin 2 'C' (cathode) and pin 4 'COLLECTOR', so the two machine sources do not share a name vocabulary (assist: 5 diffs, all naming; pad multiset 1,2,3,4 agrees everywhere). Agent geometry check of the KiCad symbol: pin 1 top-left, 2 bottom-left, 3 bottom-right, 4 top-right = the datasheet package schematic (1 anode, 2 cathode, 3 emitter, 4 collector) and EasyEDA's order A, C(athode), E, COLLECTOR. Owner decision needed: sign it after reading the datasheet p2, or add names to the symbol. Fixture value string is 'PC817'; the orderable part is the PC817C bin.
